Per-frame orchestrator for the star-field engine: the
Sourcesrc/experiments/star-field/engine/frame.ts
UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

tickStar

Per-frame update, self-rescheduling via RAF: orbits — pivot.rotation.y = phase + t·ORBIT_SPEED·speed spins — spinner.rotation.y advances by SPIN_SPEED·spin·dt satellites — same orbit formula on child pivots fly — eased camera tween overrides manual control until done render — RenderPipeline post chain when it built (bloom → vignette → film grain), plain renderer.render otherwise

  • @param s Engine state.
  • @param now RAF timestamp in ms — falls back to performance.now.

tickFrame

The frame body — separated from tickStar so a throw in any update/render step is catchable at the self-rescheduling boundary.

  • @param s Engine state.
  • @param now RAF timestamp in ms — falls back to performance.now.
